title: Bismuth Awards
description: This mod adds the all new Bismuth Award! Ment for Bismuth SMP Season 2.
body:
# Bismuth Awards!

Have you ever wanted to have an award from a application only SMP? Well this mod is for you! You can get prestine quality with the 2 letter trophy and fits perfectly in your room!

## Features

When put onto a item frame, it stands up so you can pose the trophy!

![Bismuth SMP Award sitting on Spruce Wood on a stage. Invisible item frame used.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8250665690609bd5a3442cfe60d3b58485cd41e.png)

Yeah sadily this is the only part of the mod, it is still very cool though!
